bio.text: Gregg Hull is the Republican nominee for governor of New Mexico in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He first won election as mayor of Rio Rancho in 2014 and is described as the longest-serving mayor in the city's history.
Hull won the Republican nomination in the June 2026 primary over Doug Turner and Duke Rodriguez.
